description: Descriptive paired evaluation on predefined synthetic geology and sensor stresses. Evaluation configurations are held out from policy development, not a random sample of real geology.

cases.label: Reference
cases.description: Original geometry and sensor; software and reference control only.

cases.label: Flat control
cases.description: Flat, undisturbed target; a feedback policy should not create a placement advantage.

cases.label: Reverse dip
cases.description: Upward regional dip and upward structural change, with nominal sensor calibration.

cases.label: Steeper / narrower
cases.description: Stronger regional dip and an 18-ft target; increased measurement noise.

cases.label: Biased sensor
cases.description: Unmodeled +12 API bias, fivefold noise and a 16-ft target.

cases.label: Calibration mismatch
cases.description: The controller retains its 2 API/ft calibration while the sensor uses 1.2 API/ft and -4 API bias.

cases.label: Missing measurements
cases.description: 35% step-keyed missing observations with a sharper structural change.

cases.label: Delayed measurements
cases.description: Measurements arrive three 50-ft steps late, retaining their original acquisition pose.

cases.label: Thin / abrupt change
cases.description: An 8-ft target and 38-ft change over 80 ft challenge the command interval and curvature limits.

cases.label: Saturation / large change
cases.description: An 85-ft abrupt change and narrower instrument range remove usable measurements; HOLD is the fixed fallback.
